key_insight: OrthoPilot is a large language model–based clinical AI system that integrates hospital data and external medical knowledge to support longitudinal musculoskeletal care from diagnosis through rehabilitation.
clinical_relevance: The system may help clinicians make more consistent, evidence-based decisions across fragmented care pathways for musculoskeletal patients.
method: Built a specialist-validated benchmark from real-world electronic health records covering 1,000 disease codes.
Compared against 81 orthopaedic physicians in reader studies across diagnosis, decision-making, and management planning.
Tested in a prospective study of 1,870 complex cases and an 8-month randomized deployment in 8,240 inpatients.
evidence_signal: Across evaluations, OrthoPilot outperformed expert clinicians and other systems, improving full-chain management success by 10.6% and cumulative cases per bed by 9.7%.
watch_item: Real-world adoption will require careful validation of safety, workflow fit, data integration, and performance across diverse hospitals and patient populations.
